**Name:**

**Instructions:** Complete the following activity individually, then we will discuss as a class.

## Activity

**Context:** You are a statistical consultant, and a client reaches out to you to ask about some data they are working with. The client is a staff librarian for the county library system.

**Client's email:**

> We are trying to predict whether a library book will be returned on time or not, using information on the genre of book, the number of pages, and when it was published. We fit a least squares regression model, but the results are confusing -- for one book the model predicted a 110% chance that it was returned on time. What does this mean?

**Your task:** Write a short email to your client below, answering their question.
